title: Fix Play Site Metabolism Auto Import
description: The play site at compose/sites/play auto-imports /metabolism.zip via Sketchpad's importKitUrls, but the file is not served. public/ does not contain metabolism.zip and vite.config.ts middleware only serves /assets/* from the shared assets folder. The fetch falls through to Vite's SPA fallback (index.html), causing "Unexpected token '<', '<!doctype '..." JSON parse error in deserializeKit. Fix vite.config.ts to serve /metabolism.zip from compose/assets/compose/metabolism.zip in dev/preview and include it in the production build output.
summary: Fixed "Metabolism is not loading" on the play site. Root cause: compose/sites/play/index.tsx:49 passes importKitUrls=["/metabolism.zip"] to Sketchpad, but compose/sites/play/public/ did not contain metabolism.zip and the vite middleware only served /assets/*. The fetch fell through to Vite's SPA fallback returning index.html, which deserializeKit then tried to JSON.parse, producing "Unexpected token '<', '<!doctype '...". Fix applied to compose/sites/play/vite.config.ts: extended the serve-wasm-and-assets middleware to stream /metabolism.zip from compose/assets/compose/metabolism.zip with Content-Type application/zip in dev, and added a generateBundle hook that emits the file into dist/ during production build (rollup this.emitFile asset). Verified end-to-end by starting vite dev on port 4001 and curl-ing /metabolism.zip: HTTP 200, Content-Type application/zip, 15,201,967 bytes, valid zip per `file` command; production `vite build` now writes dist/metabolism.zip (15,201,967 bytes, matching assets source, replacing the previously stale 20MB copy). Single source of truth is compose/assets/compose/metabolism.zip — no file duplication into public/.
